thread:
Elena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Opening a short thread to capture asks about why we win/lose and how we close the loop back to roadmap.
Ravi: Observed signals: wins = Dedicated SLA + predictable p95 for common configs; losses = integration handoffs and surprises in projected spend.
Priya: Example from CS this week: prospect expected flat costs but hit a higher slab when batch sizes changed. They asked for a simple estimator and an "expected variance" note.
Jun: Actionable: I'll draft a 1-page guided-deploy runbook for Private with a smoke-test checklist and expected timing per step. Will include a minimal curl check and KMS healthcheck.
Sam: Sales ask: can we get a short "cost estimator" spreadsheet (range-based) and two canned scenarios so reps can run numbers live on calls?
Nora: Also suggest a small "SLA badge" snippet for proposals showing p50/p95 and uptime numbers per tier. Helps legal and procurement moves faster.
Priya: For feedback loops: let's tag each lost opportunity in CRM with a primary reason (cost/integration/security/feature). Rev Ops should batch these into a weekly "loss digest" for Product.
Elena: Leadership ask: who owns the one-pager + estimator + runbook? Need owners and ETAs in this thread.
Jun: I'll own the runbook + smoke-tests. ETA 6 business days.
Sam: I'll prototype the estimator spreadsheet and two scenarios. ETA 5 business days.
Ravi: I'll coordinate the SLA badge copy with Legal and PMM. ETA 8 business days.
Priya: Rev Ops will wire CRM lost-opportunity tags to a weekly Product digest; Sarah volunteered. ETA 2 weeks.
Elena: Nice. Two prioritization notes from leadership: 1) prioritize artifacts that unblock deals in negotiation (estimator + SLA snippet), 2) do the runbook as the next highest priority.
Nora: Can we also add a 3-line decision checklist for CS: 1) latency target, 2) data residency/SLA must-haves, 3) cost ceiling. Reps want this short and usable.
Jun: I'll include that checklist in the runbook.
Sam: Tiny ask for estimator: include a "variance" cell that shows +/- 20% for typical burst patterns and a note on batching impact (e.g., batching up reduces per-token cost but may add ~10-30ms latency).
Priya: Good. Also request: a redacted one-paragraph case study of a customer who moved Hosted->Dedicated and saw a >30% per-token saving + more predictable latency. Sales says this converts.
Ravi: I can pull a sanitized blurb from onboarding, redact customer name, and share by EOW.
ops-bot: Created ticket #5238 "AH follow-up: estimator + runbook + SLA snippet" assigned to Jun, Sam, Ravi. Due 2026-04-22.
Elena: Recap owners & ETAs: Jun = runbook + smoke-tests + checklist (6bd), Sam = estimator + scenarios (5bd), Ravi = SLA badge copy + redacted case blurb (8bd), Rev Ops/Sarah = CRM->weekly loss digest (2w). Leadership will review drafts in 48h of submission.
Nora: GTM will do rapid review and provide replay scripts for objection handling. Tag us when drafts are available.
Elena: Thanks all. Treat this thread as canonical for these asks and we'll include progress in the next all-hands notes.
